'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Wad Al-Noora massacre]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] storm the village of [[Wad Al-Noora]] in [[Gezira State]], [[Sudan]], and massacre nearly 100 villagers. [https://sudantribune.com/article286609/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[2021–2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
**At least 16 people are killed in [[Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. The local government believes the [[Allied Democratic Forces]] are responsible. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-16-killed-by-suspected-islamists-eastern-congo-local-official-says-2024-06-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Beirut US embassy shooting]]
**A [[Syria]]n man fires several shots at [[Embassy of the United States, Beirut|the U.S. Embassy]] in [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], and is shot by security forces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gunman-fires-shots-us-embassy-beirut-lebanese-army-says-2024-06-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] strikes an [[Iron Dome]] battery in [[Ramot Naftali]], [[Israel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanons-hezbollah-says-it-targeted-israels-iron-dome-ramot-naftali-2024-06-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Korean conflict]]
**The [[United States of America|United States]] and [[South Korea]] participate in the first [[Precision-guided munition|precision guided bombing]] drill in 7 years over the [[Korea|Korean Peninsula]], as tensions rise after [[North Korea]] sends trash-filled balloons into South Korea. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/06/05/world/video/us-south-korea-live-munitions-exercise-north-korea-trash-balloons-ripley-digvid-ebof (CNN)] [https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-us-bomber-jdam-aa288f398e1387abe3d7eea82e2b2c2d (AP)]

** Four [[Slovakia|Slovaks]] and [[Ukraine|Ukrainians]] are killed and more than 20 others are injured when a [[passenger train]] collides with a [[freight train]] in [[Pardubice]], [[Czech Republic]]. '''Health and environment'''
*A panel of the [[United States Food and Drug Administration]] rejects [[MDMA-assisted psychotherapy]] as a treatment for [[PTSD]]. [https://www.npr.org/sections/shots-health-news/2024/06/04/nx-s1-4991112/mdma-therapy-ptsd-fda-advisors (NPR)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Burkina Faso–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]]n [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] announces that Russia will send additional military supplies and instructors to [[Burkina Faso]] to help the country increase its defense capabilities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-provide-more-military-aid-instructors-burkina-faso-2024-06-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mexico–United States border crisis]]
**[[President of the United States|US President]] [[Joe Biden]] institutes a broad [[asylum seeker|asylum]] ban on migrants illegally crossing the [[Mexico–United States border]], with actions to deport or turn people back to [[Mexico]], with exceptions for unaccompanied children, people with serious medical or safety threats, and victims of [[trafficking]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/biden-expected-block-migrants-asylum-us-mexico-border-sources-say-2024-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*A court in [[Florence]], [[Italy]], convicts [[United States|American]] journalist [[Amanda Knox]] and sentences her to a three-year imprisonment over her accusations related to the murder of [[Murder of Meredith Kercher|Meredith Kercher]] in [[Perugia, Italy|Perugia]] in 2007. The sentence will count as time already served. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/amanda-knox-italy-court-slander-meredith-kercher-murder-rcna155363 (NBC News)] [https://www.npr.org/2024/06/05/g-s1-2889/amanda-knox-italy-court-slander-charge (NPR)]
